name: ASAP GLOBAL TELECOM LTDA
notes:
ASAP Global Telecom (AS264144) is a Brazilian carrier operating our own
 backbone in Sao Paulo and our own Tier III designed data center, ASAP SP1.

 **Open peering policy.** We peer at IX.br Sao Paulo and IX.br Fortaleza and are
 present at Equinix SP2, SP3 and SP4, Tecto TFOR1/2 (submarine cable landing
 station, Fortaleza), Eletronet, DC Matrix and TIVIT Sao Paulo.

 **What we offer international networks:** IP transit, dedicated capacity,
 colocation at ASAP SP1 with a 99.987% contractual SLA, and cross connects
 across our Sao Paulo footprint.
